## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 380 captures during October 2019. This provides the activity total for the month and indicates the volume submitted for image review and subsequent grading. The activity figure is reported for the site as a whole.

## Image quality

Image quality review identified 16 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 4.2 per cent. These results are reported together to show both the number of captures that could not be graded and their proportion of the total activity. The findings should be considered alongside the overall capture volume for October 2019.

## Grading

Grading identified 70 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 2. This provides the central measure of the time taken for grading during the reporting month. The grading results and the image-quality findings form the main operational measures for West Gate Eye Clinic for October 2019.
